metadata.title: Antigane — Building Game, Blockchain & AI Products
metadata.description: Discover Peridot, Peridot ID, and Live2dev — products built under Antigane for game distribution, Web3 identity infrastructure, and creator-driven game campaigns.

hero.heading: Building Game, Blockchain, and AI Products.
hero.tagline: Antigane builds products across game distribution, blockchain infrastructure, AI developer tools, and creator-powered discovery.

game.title: Game
game.body: Building platforms that help games get discovered, distributed, and grown by players.

blockchain.title: Blockchain
blockchain.body: Creating wallet, licensing, and payment infrastructure for digital products.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.body: Developing intelligent tools that help creators and developers build faster.

peridot.title: Peridot
peridot.body: A game distribution platform where players discover, access, and help grow the games they love through a more connected gaming ecosystem.

peridotId.title: Peridot ID
peridotId.body: A unified identity platform giving every product in the Peridot ecosystem one sign-in, shared sessions, and player profiles that follow players everywhere.

live2dev.title: Live2dev
live2dev.body: A game campaign marketplace that connects game developers with streamers to promote and grow their games.
